灰色地面上有许多撞击坑。水星没有像地球一样浓厚的大气，岩石直接面对太空环境。: Many impact craters mark this grey rocky ground. Mercury lacks an atmosphere like Earth’s; its rocks face the space environment.
水星是类地行星，表面由岩石和风化层构成。它拥有极稀薄的外逸层，不能把它画成具有蓝: Mercury is terrestrial, with rock and regolith at its surface. Its extremely tenuous exosphere does not produce an Earth-like blue sky or thick clouds.
坑洼来自撞击，球体轮廓仍由重力维持。: Impacts roughen the surface, while gravity preserves the planet’s overall round shape.
从太空看，厚云遮住了金星的地面。继续往下，才会看到昏黄天空下的岩石平原和火山地貌: Thick clouds hide Venus’s ground from space. Beneath them are rocky plains and volcanic terrain under a dim yellowish sky.
金星有固体地表；二氧化碳大气和硫酸云不能等同于地面。表面约 467°C，气压约为: Venus has solid ground beneath a carbon-dioxide atmosphere and sulfuric-acid clouds. Its surface is about 467°C and 92 times Earth’s sea-level pressure: solid ground does not imply habitability.
切换剖面，分清看见的云和被遮住的地面。: Use the section to distinguish visible clouds from the hidden ground.
海水覆盖了地球的大部分表面，但海洋下面有岩石海床。地球不是一个从外到内全是水的球: Ocean covers most of Earth, but a rocky seabed lies beneath it. Earth is not a ball made entirely of water.
海洋覆盖约 71% 的地球表面。海面是液体与大气的界面，海床是水与岩石的界面；讨: Oceans cover about 71% of Earth. The sea surface is a liquid–atmosphere interface; the seabed is a water–rock interface. “Surface” needs a stated meaning.

火星有岩石、沙尘和高低起伏的地形。它的红色主要来自含铁矿物的氧化，地面并不是正在: Mars has rocks, dust and varied terrain. Oxidized iron minerals give it a reddish color; the ground is not on fire.
火星属于岩石行星，具有稀薄且以二氧化碳为主的大气。地表颜色并非只有红色，也有棕、: Mars is rocky with a thin, mostly carbon-dioxide atmosphere. Its surface also contains browns, greys and golds. Ancient channels record a wetter past.
比较火星和地球：都有岩石，外部环境却很不同。: Compare Mars with Earth: both have rock, but their environments differ.
木星的条纹和旋涡不是大陆。向下穿过云层，周围会越来越稠密，却不会遇到一个像地球地: Jupiter’s stripes and swirls are not continents. Below the clouds, material grows denser without an Earth-like landing surface.
木星属于气态巨行星，主要由氢和氦构成。内部压力和温度随深度增加，物质性质逐渐变化: Jupiter is a gas giant dominated by hydrogen and helium. Pressure, temperature and material properties change with depth. “Gas giant” does not mean a tenuous interior or a planet a spacecraft can fly through.

海王星是冰巨星。其内部包含较多水、氨、甲烷等重于氢氦的成分，在高压高温下具有复杂: Neptune is an ice giant enriched in water, ammonia, methane and other constituents heavier than hydrogen and helium. Its deep high-pressure fluids and internal structure remain model-dependent. It is not a confirmed example of an exposed liquid-ocean planet.
